capabilities: Convert pasted Windows paths into Markdown links
Open folder links with the Windows default folder handler
Create a folder named after the current note and insert its link
Delegate file, internal and web links to Obsidian's native follow-link command
extras: Windows desktop only; the README states the plugin is not tied to Q-Dir and that any folder manager set as the Windows default folder handler works. It runs PowerShell only to activate a configured folder-manager window, and collects no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian treats pasted Windows paths as plain text and cannot open links to folders outside the vault.

relations.evidence: The paste-to-link behavior was inspired by Obsidian Open in File Explorer, which is also MIT-licensed.

requires.name: Windows default folder handler or an optional folder manager such as Q-Dir

summary: Converts pasted Windows filesystem paths into readable Markdown links and opens folder links with the Windows default folder handler.
